title: Vetoes and EU Funds, 2020–2024
grammar: The More, the More: Minél … annál …
goal: I can link the number of parties to the difficulty of a decision with *minél … annál …*.
I can describe the veto disputes in the EU, with years and with the source of each view.
I can use the words of EU decision-making (*vétó*, *egyhangúság*, *csúcstalálkozó*).
